description.zh: 回档后的集合名称，不能和数据库中现有的文档名称相同，与originCollections一一对应，多个集合用英文逗号分隔，例如`newColl1,newColl2`。
description.en: The names of the collections after restoration. These names must not be the same as any existing document names in the database and must correspond one-to-one with the originCollections. Separate multiple collection names with commas, such as `newColl1,newColl2`.

description.zh: 待回档集合名称，多个集合用英文逗号分隔，例如`coll1,coll2`。
description.en: Names of the collections to be restored. Separate multiple collection names with commas, such as `coll1,coll2`.
